card.name: Small words inside dosing and timing phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as in, or, into and once in dosing directions. They come right after a drop count, a food temperature, a time point or a dose amount.

modes.label: Eye drop instructions
modes.description: The word in or into right after 'one drop' in eye-drop directions.

modes.description: The word or inside a paired limit such as 'at or below' or 'on or before'.

modes.label: Time or frequency after amount

card.writes: It seems to favor words that continue a clause with a contrast or concession, and to disfavor words meaning 'any' or 'whenever'.
card.plain: It marks small connecting words in dosing directions, like 'one drop in each eye' or 'at or below room temperature'.
